description_en: Queries the disaster recovery drills that were performed on the replication pair whose secondary disk resides in a specific region
description_zh: 该接口用于查询当前地域的盘作为复制对从端时，曾经对复制对所启动的容灾演练
kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-pair-drills --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drill-id drill-xxxx --pair-id pair-xxxx --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePairDrills

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the primary or secondary disk in the async replication pair. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html operation to query the most recent list of regions in which async replication is supported
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制对中主盘或从盘所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html operation to query a list of asynchronous replication pairs, including replication pair IDs
parameters.help_zh: 复制对ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html接口查询异步复制对列表，获得复制对ID入参的值
parameters.name: pair_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to be returned. You can use this parameter together with NextToken.

Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
本次调用期望查询的最大条目数。可配合NextToken参数一起使用。

取值范围：1~500。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous call to the DescribeDiskReplicaPairs operation. Leave this parameter empty the first time you call this operation. When you specify NextToken, the PageSize and PageNumber request parameters do not take effect and the TotalCount response parameter is invalid
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。如果设置了NextToken，则请求参数PageSize和PageNumber将失效，且返回数据中的TotalCount无效
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围1-100
parameters.name: page_size
